title: Counting On from Any Number
short: Start counting from a number other than 1.
trouble: Children go back to 1 every time instead of starting from the given number.

blocks.html: You don’t always have to start at 1. You can count from any number.
Start at the number you are given and keep going: 6, 7, 8, 9 …
The count from 1 to 6 is already done. Starting at 6 skips the part you already know, so it is quicker, and the numbers after 6 are the same as always.
Going back to 1 every time. Instead, put the start number “in your head”: tap your head, say it, then count on.
For grown-ups: Play “start at” games: “Start at 8 and count to 15.” Take turns being the one who picks the start.

sources.name: Common Core State Standards for Mathematics, Kindergarten, K.CC.A.2: count forward beginning from a given number
